text: The User Interface Designer will design the LCD screen function menu. The UI Designer will prepare a list of the functions to be shown on the screen/menu and group the menu into a display group and a basic functions group. There are problems to clarify specific functions and to simplify for elderly users, indicating need for simpler remote. Decisions set two menus (button-based and LCD/TV options), with two function groups and advanced options on screen, and screen positioning on top; Teletext is skipped and target age range 16-40.
